text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

Our first meeting of the New Year began 
with a polite greeting from Nishino 
Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's the Classic year starting now, isn't 
it? I'm sure there are plenty of races you 
want to challenge as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got to make 
you smile, Trainer! I look forward to 
working with you again this year!

Nishino Flower's smile was shining 
brightly. It felt like this year would be 
another peaceful one—with that thought in 
mind, I asked her a question.
choice_data_list: Do you have a goal for this year?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I do!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's "grow big"!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I had my height measured during the health 
checkup the other day, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Since our serious training started, I've 
been eating more than before, so I really 
thought I'd grown a little bit taller.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still... nothing changed at all. I hadn't 
grown by even a single millimeter...”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm really hoping to grow big 
and strong soon!
choice_data_list: It's okay, you don't need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's true, isn't it? I know that, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are so many wonderful older girls at 
Tracen Academy. Watching them always makes 
me want to hurry up and grow up, too...

I understand her feelings, but some things 
can't be solved by sheer effort alone. How 
can I get her into a more positive 
mindset...?
choice_data_list: Want to go do a bunch of jumping?
Let's hear what the big girl has to say!
Shall we study how to grow bigger?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Jump...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Waaah, they're jumping on trampolines...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, everyone looks like they're 
having so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, they're all smaller than me... 
Would I just be getting in the way?”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Did you come to jump on the trampoline 
too, Flower-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mayano-san!

Mayano Top Gun. Nishino Flower's 
classmate; apparently they often eat lunch 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya loves this place! When everyone 
bounces together, you can fly super high 
up☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The more the merrier! Come on, 
Flower-chan, bounce along with us!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: H-Hyahh...! That's too high, Mayano-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ It got even bigger than 
Flower-chan's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right...! Fufu♪ It's gotten so 
big!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A big girl...?
(Simmer simmer simmer...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Flower-chan wants to grow up 
fast, doesn't she? ☆

I turned to Hishi Akebono for advice. She 
has a big body and a big heart, and I've 
heard she's close friends with Nishino 
Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. That is true, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of hot pot that is...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's chanko nabe~! The hot pot dish I've 
been eating tons of ever since I was a 
kid!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's true for everyone 
else, but I'm pretty sure this hot pot is 
what helped me grow big and strong.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So please, Flower-chan, help yourself! Eat 
up and grow big and strong!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Did you make this... just for me...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Haaah, so warm...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like I can really grow big 
and strong now...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank goodness☆ I'm still gonna get 
way bigger, too~ Let's grow together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some seconds! There are still 
three more hot pots left, so eat up, okay? 
♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes—wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're right! I'd love to learn.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I think I might know someone 
knowledgeable about that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“—Those are all the books with specific 
information on 'growing taller.'”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All the books selected are grounded in 
definitive facts. I am sure you will find 
useful references among them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... um.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking... maybe I could help 
you out with your experiments, perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's quite an alluring offer. 
However—
choice_data_list: Let me think it over at home...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Trainer stopped me. 
Besides, there's no merit for me in 
conducting that experiment. At least, not 
at present.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Read books steadily and learn as much as 
you can. Things of immediate value, 
nourishment for your future... I'm sure 
you will grasp something. Well then, 
farewell.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Tachyon-san is so cool. If I study 
hard too, maybe..."
choice_data_list: Maybe you can become like that too.
Maybe you can become like that too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right. I'm gonna do my best!
